house_rules.rule: An event that a state has no transition for is ignored in that state: no transition is written for it and it is not an error.
A duration the specification gives without a unit is read in milliseconds.
A count or a size the specification gives is an unsigned 32-bit integer unless the specification says otherwise.
A timer started on entering a state is cancelled on leaving that state.
The first state the specification describes is the initial state.
A failure the specification does not route is reported to the caller as an event and is not retried.
